description: Make mo update recoverable with product-level stages, runner restoration, runtime consistency verification, and stale status reconciliation

tasks.title: CLI update stage machine with product-level stages and recovery
tasks.description: Restructure SourceCodeUpdater.UpdateAllAsync into a stage machine with explicit UpdateStage transitions, product-level output labels, CancellationToken-based interruption handling, and runner recovery on failure or Ctrl-C. Add runner-was-running tracking via IServiceInstaller query before stop.
acceptanceCriteria: mo update displays product-level stages: Updating CLI, Preparing workflow runner, Updating Mohist Server, Waiting for Mohist to become usable, Restoring workflow runner
Runner-stopped window is visible with message that workflows are paused
Long readiness waits show current wait reason (waiting for Mohist API, waiting for Web assets) updated at bounded intervals
Runner restore is attempted when update fails after runner stop
Runner restore is attempted on Ctrl-C/SIGINT when runner was stopped
Ctrl-C before runner stop exits cleanly without recovery attempt
Final output states one of: ready, recovered with warnings, or failed with specific capability
Recovery failure prints direct next action command for manual runner start
CLI tests cover: success path, server build failure recovery, readiness timeout recovery, Ctrl-C interruption recovery, runner restore success, runner restore failure, Ctrl-C before runner stop
tasks.output: Refactored SourceCodeUpdater in packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Update.cs with UpdateStage, UpdateContext, and stage-driven UpdateAllAsync
tasks.notes: D1, D2, D3 from design.md. Introduce UpdateStage enum and UpdateContext record. Use InvocationContext.GetCancellationToken() for interruption. Keep existing sub-methods (UpdateCliAsync, UpdateServerAsync, UpdateRunnerAsync) but wire them through stage transitions.

tasks.title: Post-update runtime consistency verification
tasks.description: Add a Verifying workflow runtime stage that checks CLI binary callability, Server API identity match against source HEAD, Web asset availability, Runner connection state, and managed skill asset presence. Aggregate results into the final outcome (ready/recovered/failed).
acceptanceCriteria: Verification stage checks CLI binary via mo --version
Verification stage checks Server identity via GET /api/system/info comparing running.gitHash to source HEAD
Verification stage checks Web assets via GET / and /assets/* reference
Verification stage checks Runner via GET /api/system/info services.runner
Verification stage checks managed skill assets at ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data/manifest.json
Server identity mismatch produces recovered-with-warnings outcome
Runner not connected produces failed outcome with Runner unavailable
Missing skill assets produces recovered-with-warnings outcome
All checks pass produces ready outcome
CLI tests cover: all-pass, server-identity-mismatch, runner-unavailable, skill-assets-missing, web-assets-unavailable
tasks.output: Verification stage logic in SourceCodeUpdater with per-component check methods
tasks.notes: D6 from design.md. Reuse existing readiness probing (CheckServerReadyOnceAsync) for server/asset checks. Use HttpClient for server info and CLI self-exec for binary check.

tasks.title: Server-side staleness reconciliation and CLI outcome persistence endpoint
tasks.description: Extend SystemUpdateJobState with superseded and recovered status values, Outcome field, and UnavailableCapability field. Add staleness reconciliation to GetLatestStatusAsync that marks waiting-for-reconnect jobs as superseded when running server hash differs. Add POST /api/system/update/outcome endpoint for CLI outcome persistence. Add GET /api/system/consistency endpoint that aggregates system info and service status into a per-component consistency verdict.
acceptanceCriteria: SystemUpdateJobState supports status values: succeeded, failed, recovered, superseded, waiting-for-reconnect, running
SystemUpdateJobState has optional Outcome field (succeeded/recovered/failed) and UnavailableCapability field
GetLatestStatusAsync transitions waiting-for-reconnect to superseded when running.gitHash differs from job's sourceHead and running hash is non-empty
Active waiting-for-reconnect (matching hash or empty running hash) is preserved as-is
POST /api/system/update/outcome accepts outcome payload and persists via ISystemUpdateStore
CLI outcome POST marks older waiting-for-reconnect Web jobs as superseded when sourceHead differs
Superseded status does not block new update starts (IsActive returns false)

Server tests cover: stale-to-superseded transition, active-preserved, empty-hash-preserved, outcome-persistence, superseded-non-blocking, CLI-outcome-supersedes-stale-web-job, consistency-all-coherent, consistency-runner-unavailable, consistency-assets-mismatched
tasks.output: Extended SystemUpdateJobState, staleness logic in SystemUpdateService.GetLatestStatusAsync, POST /api/system/update/outcome endpoint in SystemRoutes, and GET /api/system/consistency endpoint
tasks.notes: D4, D5, D8 from design.md. Add outcome persistence endpoint that bypasses lock (CLI outcome is always accepted). Add consistency endpoint that aggregates SystemInfoService data with service status. Run existing SystemUpdateService tests to verify no regressions.

tasks.title: Web-triggered update runner recovery
tasks.description: Add runner restore logic to the Web-triggered update flow in SystemUpdateService.RunUpdateAsync. When a build or server restart fails, attempt to restore the runner if it was detected as present before the update began.
acceptanceCriteria: RunUpdateAsync checks runner unit presence before server restart
On build failure, runner restore is attempted
On server restart command failure, runner restore is attempted
Runner restore outcome is reflected in update job state (recovered or failed with unavailable capability)
Server tests cover: build-failure-runner-restore-success, build-failure-runner-restore-failure, server-restart-failure-runner-restore-success
tasks.output: Runner recovery logic in SystemUpdateService.RunUpdateAsync with updated job state transitions
tasks.notes: Extends the fire-and-forget RunUpdateAsync. Must record runnerWasPresent before restart and attempt systemctl --user restart on failure. Use existing RunCommandAsync helper for the restore command.

tasks.title: CLI outcome persistence integration
tasks.description: Wire up the CLI stage machine to POST the final update outcome to POST /api/system/update/outcome after verification completes and the server is reachable. Generate a job ID for the CLI update and include stage log entries.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI generates a job ID at update start
CLI posts outcome to POST /api/system/update/outcome after verification stage
Outcome payload includes job ID, status, outcome label, unavailable capability, stage logs
CLI outcome is skipped with a message when server is not reachable
Web UI can read CLI outcome via GET /api/system/update/status
CLI tests cover: outcome-posted-success, outcome-skipped-when-server-unreachable, web-ui-can-read-cli-outcome
tasks.output: Outcome HTTP posting logic in SourceCodeUpdater and corresponding API client helper
tasks.notes: D5 from design.md. Use existing HttpClient in SourceCodeUpdater to POST. Post only when server is reachable (verified during readiness). Outcome is best-effort persistence — terminal always shows result.

tasks.title: Web UI stale state handling, outcome display, and shared stage semantics
tasks.description: Update Settings > System page to handle superseded update status (show as no longer relevant, display current runtime instead), render outcome labels (Succeeded/Recovered with warnings/Failed with unavailable capability), add Restoring runner and Verifying runtime stages to progress display, and ensure update progress uses same stage names as CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: Superseded status is displayed as previous update no longer relevant, not as active update
Current runtime identity (version, git hash) is shown alongside superseded state
Completed updates show outcome label: Succeeded, Recovered with warnings, or Failed with specific capability
Update progress shows stages: Building, Restarting server, Waiting for reconnect, Restoring runner, Verifying runtime
CLI-triggered update outcome is visible in Settings > System after page refresh
Web tests cover: superseded-display, outcome-labels, CLI-outcome-visible, stage-names-match-cli
tasks.output: Updated SystemSettings UI components and update status query/type definitions in packages/web/src/entities/settings/
tasks.notes: D7 from design.md. Extend SystemUpdateStatusResponse type with outcome and unavailableCapability fields. Update ProgressStages component to include new stages. Handle superseeded in useSystemUpdateStatus hook.
